decisions.statement: An initiative is found through the page type reached by its id rather than by a spelled slug.
An index filing no initiative draws no initiative.
An initiative's slug is read off its file's name rather than out of its page.
A parent is answered as a slug.
That edge is read by id while the tree is built from slugs.
A parent edge is read from beside the parent's page.
The parent edge is found through the property reached by its id rather than by a spelled slug.
That edge is read under the property's own slug rather than under the key a page spells.
An initiative under other than one parent is answered as under no parent.
A persona is read out of the page.
The intents an initiative has are read out of the page.
The intents are answered in the order the page states the intents.
An entry stating no statement is no intent and is passed over.
An intent stating no working memory has no working memory.
A page is opened once however many keys are read out of that page.
The index files identities, and an edge sits beside the page it names.
Every initiative answered is an initiative the index named first.

definition: every initiative the work panel draws, what each has, and the one each sits under
